response.justification: The candidate demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a broad technical background, but lacks direct experience with the core requirements of the role: C++ on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, and fixed-income/capital-markets domain expertise. Their experience is heavily skewed toward web/mobile technologies, which limits their immediate fit for this specialized position.
strengths: Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple languages and frameworks (e.g., Dlang, Node.js, TypeScript).
Strong communication skills and experience sharing knowledge through workshops and talks.
Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments (e.g., low-latency systems at Sociomantic).
concerns: No explicit C++ experience on Windows or SQL Server/Oracle in recent roles.
Lacks domain expertise in fixed-income, capital markets, or investment banking.
Most recent work focuses on full-stack web/AI tooling, not systems programming or financial systems.
